lines.t: We regularize the attention weights by penalizing their entropy across
heads, which keeps each head focused on a small set of tokens. In con-
trast to dropout, the penalty acts on the distribution itself and needs
no extra parameters. We find that a modest weight is enough to stabilize
The second effect is on interpretability: heads that attend to fewer
tokens are easier to inspect, and their patterns recur across layers in
a way that the unregularized model does not show.
